verification_report.summary: The fact is supported as stated. The predecessor fact supplies the exact Baffet remainder R_sigma = -int u grad(a).lambda. For the displayed elliptic candidate z = L^{-1} div(u grad a), the weak form has the stated negative sign, time-independent coefficients give A(z_t,v)=-(u_t grad a,grad v), and the full derivative of eta[(lambda,grad z)+A(z,z)/2] is exactly eta[(lambda_t,grad z)+(lambda-u grad a,grad z_t)]. Thus (E_B+F)' retains the original Baffet remainder and adds lambda_t/u_t-dependent terms rather than cancelling it. The scalar proxy, second-elliptic-variable residual, temporal-primitive residual, and positivity/equivalence caveats are all reproduced in the cited proof/report and by rerun SymPy and Lean checks. The cited source text also confirms this is the same displayed candidate, and the artifacts limit the rejection to that candidate and the two audited repairs, not all possible nonlocal Lyapunov operators.
